members: @GetMapping("/api/v1/ledger/devices/{deviceId}/revisions") public Flux<TelemetryRecordResponse> revisions(@PathVariable String deviceId, @RequestParam String metric, @RequestParam @DateTimeFormat(iso = DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE_TIME) Instant tDevice) { return Flux.defer(() -> useCase.revisionChain(deviceId, metric, tDevice)).map(r -> new TelemetryRecordResponse(r.id(), r.deviceId(), r.metric(), r.value(), r.tDevice(), r.tIngress(), r.validationStatus(), r.revision(), r.supersedesId())).onErrorMap(IllegalArgumentException.class, e -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, e.getMessage(), e)); }
signature: public Flux<TelemetryRecordResponse> records(@PathVariable String deviceId, @RequestParam @DateTimeFormat(iso = DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE_TIME) Instant from, @RequestParam @DateTimeFormat(iso = DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE_TIME) Instant to, @RequestParam(defaultValue = "false") boolean latestOnly)
body:
return Flux.defer(() -> latestOnly
        ? useCase.latestHistory(deviceId, from, to)
        : useCase.history(deviceId, from, to))
        .map(r -> new TelemetryRecordResponse(r.id(), r.deviceId(), r.metric(), r.value(), r.tDevice(), r.tIngress(), r.validationStatus(), r.revision(), r.supersedesId()))
        .onErrorMap(IllegalArgumentException.class,
                e -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, e.getMessage(), e));
